content.value_statement: Business owners need accurate review links and clear messages for customer outreach. This skill uses Reach listing data to prepare drafts and guide manual delivery.
actual_capabilities: Ask which business location to use when the account has multiple locations.
Build a Google review link from a returned public-listing place identifier, or provide the review-link generator.
Draft two or three review-request sentences in the owner or customer language, with the link on a separate line.
Direct owners to external QR generation and additional message tools.
Suggest up to ten recent customers by name and service when requested and supported by an active connection.
Prepare a feature request for unsupported functions and submit it only after owner confirmation, excluding private customer details.
limitations: Requires a connected Reach MCP server and browser OAuth sign-in to the owner account.
Does not send review requests, generate QR images, or reconstruct masked phone numbers.
Connected listings do not return a place identifier; the owner must obtain the exact review link through the suggested generator.
Customer suggestions require an active connection and available records; the hosted server implementation is outside this repository.

use_cases.title: Prepare outreach after a service visit
use_cases.description: Draft a short review request using a verified service detail and an accurate review link.

use_cases.title: Prepare a reception review kit
use_cases.description: Obtain review-link guidance and the QR generator reference for a printable reception or receipt code.

use_cases.title: Coordinate outreach across locations
use_cases.description: Select the correct location and request recent customer suggestions without exposing full phone numbers or filtering by satisfaction.

prompt_templates.title: Start a review request kit
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Google review request kit for my business. Ask which location to use if needed. Do not send messages.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a localized request
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a short WhatsApp review request in [language] for [location]. Use verified service details only. Put the accurate review link separately.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a reception QR workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare review-link and QR generator guidance for [location]. Draft a neutral SMS request. Explain any missing listing data without guessing identifiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine link guidance and a message

prompt_templates.title: Select recent customers responsibly
prompt_templates.prompt: For [location], suggest up to ten customers served during [date range]. Check connection status first. Keep phones masked and do not filter by satisfaction.

output_examples.input: Prepare a WhatsApp request for a verified repair visit. The listing does not provide a place identifier.
output: Review link: Use the Reach review-link generator to obtain the exact Google review URL. No place identifier was returned.
Message draft: Thank you for visiting us for your repair. Please share your experience in a Google review.
Link placement: Put the verified review link on its own line before sending.
Delivery: The owner sends the message manually.

output_examples.input: Suggest recent customers to ask, but the location has no active customer connection.
output: Customer suggestions: Unavailable because this location does not have an active customer connection.
Next step: Review the connection guidance returned by Reach.
Review kit: Review-link guidance and a message draft remain available.

best_practices: Confirm the business location and use only a returned place identifier or an exact link obtained through the review-link generator.
Use verified visit details and request honest feedback from all customers, without incentives or preferred ratings.
Keep contact details private and send drafts manually; confirm any feature request wording before submission.
anti_patterns: Guessing place identifiers, review URLs, service details, or data freshness.
Offering rewards, asking for five-star ratings, or selecting only satisfied customers.
Reconstructing masked phone numbers, exposing unrelated customer records, or sending requests automatically.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect the Reach MCP server in your AI client and sign in to your own Reach account through browser OAuth.

faq.question: Does this skill send WhatsApp or SMS messages?
faq.answer: No. It drafts the request, and the owner sends it manually.

faq.question: What happens when the listing has no place identifier?
faq.answer: The skill provides the Reach review-link generator instead of guessing a Google review URL.

faq.question: Can the skill generate a QR image?
faq.answer: No. It directs you to the external QR generator for a printable code.

faq.question: Can it suggest customers to contact?
faq.answer: Yes, when requested and supported by an active connection. It suggests up to ten recent customers and keeps phone numbers masked.

faq.question: Can I reward customers for positive reviews?
faq.answer: No. The workflow prohibits incentives, review gating, and requests for five-star ratings.
